factual_claims.claim: The global market for AI-driven recruitment and hiring technology experienced significant growth in the years leading up to 2022.
President Joe Biden issued an executive order on October 30, 2023, imposing mandates on federal agencies' use of AI.
The Digital Services Act (DSA) in Europe entered into force in February 2024.
New York City Local Law 144, requiring bias audits for AI hiring tools, became effective in July 2023.
Only 19 audits linked to NYC Local Law 144 were published in the first 6 months after it entered into force.
The study analyzed 801 applicants who provided both a résumé and video responses for K-12 teaching positions.
The applicant pool for the study was 67% women, 2% Asian, 45% Black, 10% Hispanic, and 38% White.
The study audited 11 different LLMs from OpenAI, Mistral, and Anthropic.

Recent studies on LLM hiring bias have produced mixed results, with some indicating a preference for male candidates and others showing no significant gender preference or context-dependent variations.

A conceptual framework that views race as a complex bundle of interrelated factors rather than a single, isolatable variable.
Encompasses: Social status, wealth, religion, and neighborhood.
Excludes: Simple demographic labeling.
